descriptions.w3d_cc17d_node_reset_802c603c: Sets the name of the child handle at +28 from a temporary string made from the original "NULL" literal at 0x803d8d10 (w3d_handle_set_name, 255), then calls the child's vtable slot +76 with the owner's vector at +60 and 0 and slot +84 with a vector of three copies of the float at 0x803d8d18 and 0.
descriptions.w3d_cc17d_node_reset_802c6f64: Same as 0x802c603c for another owner class: names the +28 child from the "NULL" literal at 0x803d8de4, passes the owner's vector at +112 to vtable slot +76 and a vector of three copies of the float at 0x803d8dec to slot +84.
